issues.title: Ambiguous Concurrency Scope for Dedup Lock
issues.why: AC-04 and the retrospective code snippet define a client-side (JS) IIFE closure for deduplication, which fails if the user has multiple tabs open or restarts the app.
issues.fix: Add a requirement that critical mutations (Publish) must also implement a server-side idempotency key or lock in Tier 2 (Go).

issues.title: Regex Pattern Mismatch for Error Codes
issues.why: AC-04 in §97 defines the pattern as ^[A-Z]{2,4}-[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}$ while the Phase 50 contract in §00 defines it as ^[A-Z]{2,5}-[A-Z]+-\d{3}$.
issues.fix: Standardize all regex patterns to the Phase 50 'ErrorEvent' schema format.

issues.title: Missing Timeout on ZIP Finalization
issues.why: AC-05 mandates synchronous ZIP closing but does not specify behavior for large files or disk-full scenarios during the central directory write.
issues.fix: Add a requirement for context-aware timeouts and disk-space pre-flight checks in the ZIP service.
